<div class="card-body">
'''Walker Garrison''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウォーカー制圧部隊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：ヴィアーズがホスの屋外位置にいる場合に使用する。2フォース消費し、自分のリザーブデッキのなかからＡＴ－ＡＴを1枚探してきて手札に入れることができる。その後デッキをシャッフルし、カットして元の場所に置く。2：ホスの3箇所以上の異なった位置にそれぞれ自分のＡＴ－ＡＴがいる場合に使用する。このターン、ホスのロケーションにおける自分のフォース消耗はそれぞれ＋2となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Walker-Garrison-PSA-104758251.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ＡＴ－ＡＴ部隊を効果的に展開することにより、広範囲な地域を素早く制圧することができる。帝国が惑星を占領する際に用いる、きわめて有効な戦術だ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Walker Garrison.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. (1) Play if Veers is at an outdoor Hoth location. Spend 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck for one AT-AT and put it into your hand. Shuffle, cut and replace the deck. (2) Play if your AT-ATs occupy three or more different Hoth locations. Each of your Force drains at Hoth locations is +2 this turn.

'''Lore:'''
Deploying AT-AT units effectively makes it possible to seize control of a wide area quickly. The Empire uses this highly effective tactic when occupying a planet.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face uses 位置 (location) for those conditions and explicitly says three or more.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Walker Garrison]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
